verdict.rationale: Resend ships an official MCP server (github.com/resend/resend-mcp, referenced in resend.com/.well-known/mcp.json) and docs explicitly describe adding Resend to Cursor, Claude, and other MCP clients, plus using the MCP server for domain verification and webhook workflows.  This confirms Resend, as a service, offers a first-party MCP server for agent integration. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server's functionality and more detailed setup/capability documentation beyond brief mentions.
